description: Resumes an owned pending operation after its worker lease expires. Retries reuse staged progress without duplicating record writes. The worker rechecks publication preconditions, so a resume response does not mean publication has completed. Returns resumed: true or false.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: resume_crm_operation
title: Resume an interrupted operation
